name: teleport-requests
author: Takaro
description: Teleport Requests (/tpa): players ask to teleport to another online player (tpa) or ask someone to come to them (tpahere). The other player gets a private message and answers with tpaccept or tpdeny. Requests expire after a set time, and each player can have one open request (tpcancel withdraws it). Optional cooldown, currency cost (charged only after a successful teleport) and height offset. Players can block others with tpblock. For a warmup, set a delay on the tpaccept command in the module's command settings. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.
summary: Teleport Requests (/tpa): ask to teleport to an online player (tpa) or ask them to come to you (tpahere). They answer with tpaccept or tpdeny. Requests expire, one open request per player (tpcancel). Optional cooldown, currency cost (charged only after a successful teleport) and height offset. Players can block others with tpblock. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: How long a request stays open before it expires.

cooldown.title: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Time a player has to wait after a successful teleport before sending a new request. Players with TPA_BYPASS_COOLDOWN skip it.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Currency the requesting player pays, charged only after a successful teleport. 0 is free.

teleportYOffset.title: Teleport height offset
teleportYOffset.description: Added to the height (Y) of the destination. Raise it on games that place players inside the ground.

permissions.description: Allows a player to send requests with tpa and tpahere. Answering requests needs no permission.
The player's teleports do not start a cooldown, for example for VIPs.

tpa.description: Ask to teleport to another player
tpa.helpText: Asks an online player if you may teleport to them.

tpahere.description: Ask another player to teleport to you
tpahere.helpText: Asks an online player to teleport to you.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: The player to bring to you.

tpaccept.helpText: Accepts a teleport request. Without a name it accepts the oldest one.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Name of the player whose request to accept (optional).

tpdeny.helpText: Denies a teleport request. Without a name it denies the oldest one.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Name of the player whose request to deny (optional).

tpcancel.helpText: Withdraws the teleport request you sent.

tpblock.description: Block teleport requests from a player
tpblock.helpText: Stops a player from sending you teleport requests.

tpunblock.helpText: Lets a blocked player send you teleport requests again.
